system_prompt_style.note: Paper-only; the repo evidence provided does not include files from the zero_shot_structured_reflection subdirectory. The prompt is filled with the task goal, the screen and the reflections.

we take inspiration from Wang et al. (2023a) to heuristi-
cally simplify the HTML code of each screen
env_context_strategy.note: Closest value: the harness injects a compact HTML screen representation. It is a web environment, not a repository.

context_compaction.evidence_quote:
Note that, we also
omit former states in Eq. 4 to make inference more
efficient.
context_compaction.note: Earlier states are replaced by natural-language action summaries, and the HTML is simplified. Reflection entries for later steps are cleared.

retaining key attributes for each leaf element, i.e., id,
class, text, placeholder, value, and position on a

observation_format.note: The observation is simplified HTML/DOM text.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: click id=6 enter “text” to id=10 press ARROWDOWN x N
tool_call_format.note: Closest value: text commands in an action-specific format, parsed from the model output.

tool_count.evidence_quote:
we use three types of actions
as shown in Tab. 3.
tool_count.note: Three action types (click, type, special key), not function schemas.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote:
we use three types of actions

edit_primitive.note: There is no file-editing tool; the action space is click, type and key press only.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote:

in Appx. A.
tool_schema_source.note: Actions are described in hand-written prompts.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote:
we ask the agent to reflect on its
past action trajectory, suggest an improved version,
and then retry the task.
loop_primitives.note: Staged plan-and-follow per screen, with reflection-driven retrial.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote:
we take a step in the mid-
dle by maximally planning actions that are visible
on the current state all at once.
planning_granularity.note: The per-screen action list is generated and followed but is not a persisted plan object.

short_term_state.evidence_quote:
we use a

short_term_state.note: Reflection memory R and disabled set D are indexed by time step.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote:
accumulated entries in Rt`1

long_term_memory.note: Reflection memory persists across trials of the same task only, not across tasks.

self_verification.evidence_quote:
Once a negative signal is given, such as no change
or failed (Sec. 3.4), we ask the agent to reflect on its
past action trajectory

retry_policy.evidence_quote:
With
3 rounds of reflection trials, our agent achieved
96% completion rate on it.
retry_policy.note: The paper reports T=1, 3 and 5 trials.

rollback.note: The environment is reset per trial; this is not a rollback mechanism.

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
We broadly
categorize trial ending conditions into: 1) correct,
2) cycle, 3) no change, 4) incomplete, 5) exception,
and 6) failed.
termination_condition.note: 'Correct' is the environment reward (mapped to test_pass). The cycle and no-change detectors are stall detection.

cost_controls.note: Staged planning reduces the number of LLM calls, but no budget mechanism is described.

permission_model.note: The disabled-action set removes element ids for failed clicks; this is a planning constraint, not authorisation.

replayability.evidence_quote:
actions before this time step can be deterministically

replayability.note: This is replay of actions within a retrial.
